title: unify-terraform-private-state-layout-gpu-iam-networking-migration
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Unifies private deployment Terraform state layout and consolidates GPU node pool, IAM, and networking modules. Migration required for existing Private customers; automated migration helper provided.
description:
Motivation: Private deployments currently use several divergent Terraform state layouts across modules (gpu_node_pools, iam_roles, networking). This causes drift during upgrades (state imports, duplicate resources) and complicates cross-module references. This PR unifies the state layout and module interfaces to a single convention that supports safer migrations, simpler lockfiles, and deterministic resource naming.

Summary of changes: consolidated 'private' state backend layout under modules/state/private/, introduced a stable naming scheme for GPU node pools, normalized IAM roles and bindings to use data-driven role maps, and refactored networking outputs to expose subnet and route table IDs consistently. Added a migration helper script (tf-migrate-private.sh) that performs dry-run imports and suggests terraform state mv commands for existing customers.

Key goals: 1) Avoid duplicate resource creation during rolling upgrades between Terraform versions. 2) Make module boundaries explicit so Dedicated/Private installers can rely on exported outputs. 3) Provide a safe migration path for customers with existing state.

Migration notes: see MIGRATION.md added to the repo. The helper script supports three modes: analyze (dry-run), import (apply import commands), and adopt (state mv assisted). Customers must run analyze, inspect suggested moves, and run import/adopt in a maintenance window. Automation in the private-installer will call the helper when upgrading major state schema versions.

Testing: Unit tests for Terraform modules added (tflint and checkov CI jobs), end-to-end validation ran in internal staging with a subset of customers (gpu-small, gpu-large) and private VPC configs. Verified no downtime for canary customer when switching to new state layout using the helper.

Impact: Existing Private customers will need to follow the migration steps in MIGRATION.md. No change to runtime behavior; only state organization and resource naming normalization.

notes_for_release_engineer: This PR changes Terraform state layout for Private deployments. Before cutting a release that includes the private-installer changes, run the migration helper against staging and coordinate with the on-prem team. See MIGRATION.md for the required customer steps. No runtime config changes required in customer manifests.
